description:
Let's explore this fascinating language. And you can learn languages with TV with Lingopie - 75% OFF for Black Friday: https://learn.lingopie.com/robwords

Less than two decades ago, UNESCO declared Manx extinct. However, I've been to the Isle of Man to meet the people who still speak the language, and who insist it never died. I also find myself having to learn to speak it too. Just how much can I learn in three days? Watch to find out.
